name: 风云四解密版
english_description: A Gu Long-themed “Storm IV” (风云Ⅳ) MUD, billed in-game as Sumxin Storm -- and the same codebase as this collection's sibling xsfyssjb (Heart's Voice Storm IV Upgraded Edition): their d/dreamland/ scene files and much of the map are byte-for-byte identical, a relationship neither archive had documented before this project. The shared world leans into Gu Long's desert-frontier jianghu -- Loulan, Xinjiang, Zangbei and Liusha's “lone smoke over the vast desert” borderlands -- alongside the usual Huashan/Wudang/Shaolin central-plains sects. Registration is one of the most complete in the whole Storm family (GB/BIG5 encoding choice, real password-complexity rules, an ethnicity pick), and the central plaza's “Panlong Motianzhu” pillar doubles as a genuine read/write public bulletin board.
